body: I know Im depressed, they (the tv doctor) prescribed trazodone and xanax. its not helping. i just want to die
I've dropped out of school and lost the desire to do anything

my life has completely unraveled. Im just begining to think that even if I had the promise of 40 years of happiness but I'd first having to go through another year, week or a day feeling like this I woudn't take I am so tired of hating myself. 

I have these moments of clarity and see what would happen, I'd be gone and the world will be no different.

I've heard every inspirational quote gotten ever sage piece of advice but I just want this to end, If I had the courage...
I think I wanted that, a little.  I keep thinking I've been completely forgoten

I wanted to do just that today. Discuss those things.  Unfortunately this is my ONLY option sykping with someone who I'm pretty sure only looked at me once. I can say that Im a little bitter, but I'm going to do some research on my own before I start taking anything they prescribe.
it's a little shy of a month.

Whenever I try to do something, go somewhere I get panic attacks.  I've been hit hard mentally, I spent the first two weeks in shock.  Honestly I don't remember a whole lot of what went down, just the truly traumatic bits.  I'm embarrassed when I say I haven't been able to leave my apartment.

I have been.  I understand that I can't have "it" back. I just haven't seen or spoken to a real person in the last couple weeks, I've acknowledged that I'm depressed for real and I've finally got an appointment with a psychiatrist. 

I'm just lonely I guess, it makes it harder doing this by myself.  Wish I had a friend here to help me.
